title: svgdoc edit operations
description: Input of edit --ops: an array of operations, or an object with an ops array such as a finding's fix.

oneOf.description: Set an attribute or an inline style property

target.description: Selector: #id, tag, tag[attr="value"], :nth-of-type(n), joined by ' > '. Every match is changed. comment(N) addresses the N-th comment for remove. Targets refer to the file as it was before the batch. On a spec a target is '#id' (a node, group or edge) or ':root'.

style.description: A property of the inline style; use it when a style, not an attribute, governs the value

attr.description: Remove this attribute instead of the element; a trailing * matches a prefix
